# Copilot Instructions

This workspace contains a TypeScript MCP server that lets GitHub Copilot interact with Feishu/Lark Open Platform APIs.

Key references:

- MCP TypeScript SDK: https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/typescript-sdk
- MCP documentation: https://modelcontextprotocol.io/docs
- Feishu Open Platform API documentation: https://open.feishu.cn/document/home/index

Keep changes focused on MCP tools and the Feishu/Lark API client. Do not commit credentials; use `.env` locally or VS Code MCP input prompts.
